snippet.title: The Sealed Ampoule Console Version Announcement trailer
snippet.description:
The Sealed Ampoule - a clicker-style dungeon dungeon agriculturalization ""Rogue-lite"" tte - is coming to Nintendo Switch/PS4/XboxOne on February 3rd! Available for pre-order now!
Check here for details: https://playism.com/game/the-sealed-ampoule/
